title: feat(nm2sfzfrmrd): HOLDING neighbor-read of cyclic lex-smallest frame transport at t+1 on three-axis far-face opposite z-probes: reverse HOL
science: On the three-axis far-face opposite seed all four z-probes have split HOLD, Orient (+1,+1,-1,-1), a frame transporting to a formed six-neighbour by a signed permutation of matching determinant, and a neighbour that itself transports, so reverse and face both HOLD; this is a HOLD/HOLD cell outside the roll-up's 153. The same table records that the scalar neighbour-read of Orient fails at C, where both transporting neighbours carry +1 against Orient(C)=-1, so the frame transports where the scalar handedness sign does not agree between neighbours.
